title: Warming Cheesy Australian Rigatoni Pasta
description: A rich and satisfying Australian-inspired pasta dish, featuring caramelize onions and a generous helping of cheese.
instructions: Cook the rigatoni pasta according to the packet instructions until it is al dente, then drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until it is soft and caramelized, stirring occasionally. This will take around 20-25 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and cook for a further 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the beef mince to the saucepan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks. Cook until the mince is browned, then add the chicken stock and tomato paste. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Stir through the ricotta cheese and Parmesan cheese until they are well combined and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked rigatoni pasta to the saucepan, tossing it in the cheesy sauce until the pasta is well coated.
Transfer the pasta to a baking dish and top with the shredded mozzarella cheese. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese if desired.
